verses.text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.

segments.text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.

verses.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

segments.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

verses.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?

segments.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?

verses.text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

segments.text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

verses.text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

segments.text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

verses.text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

segments.text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

verses.text: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
